sections.title: Letter emme sound
paragraphs: The letter name is (emme) /ɛm/. Its main sound is heard in (mer) /mɛʁ/, which means sea. This letter has one spoken sound in French, though it can also be silent.

sections.title: Pronouncing letter emme
paragraphs: Close both lips gently together. Send the air out smoothly through your nose. Turn on your voice. A voiced sound is a sound where the voice is on. Put a hand on your throat to feel the gentle vibration.

sections.title: Spelling letter emme
paragraphs: This letter makes its usual sound before a vowel, as in (mer) /mɛʁ/. It also sounds the same when doubled, as in (pomme) /pɔm/. It is not pronounced in a few rare words, such as (automne) /o.tɔn/.

sections.title: Comparing letter emme
paragraphs: This French sound is just like the first sound in the English word man. Keep your lips relaxed when you close them, and speak smoothly without extra force. There is no real pitfall here.
